prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a hit while turning left. The patient had 14 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1030; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which their vehicle was struck while turning left. Complaints centered on neck and low back pain with associated muscle tightness and limited range of motion. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported symptoms. Over the course of fourteen visits, care consisted of spinal mobilization, soft tissue therapy, therapeutic exercise, and home stretching instruction. Treatment followed a typical progression, with visit frequency reduced as symptoms improved and the patient returned to daily activities. Physical examination documented paraspinal muscle tenderness and reduced cervical rotation, supporting a soft tissue strain diagnosis. Neurological screening, including reflexes, sensation, and strength, was within normal limits. No prior injury or treatment to the neck or low back is known to this provider. Billed services were reviewed and reflect single, non-duplicated charges for each encounter. Prognosis is good with continued home exercise.
